newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq falls, pressured by networking stocks.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq falls, pressured by networking stocks.

text.p: Ending three consecutive sessions of gains, Nasdaq shares slipped Tuesday under pressure from networking stocks and semiconductor equipment companies, traders said.
The Nasdaq composite index lost 10.33 points or 0.73 percent to close unofficially at 1401.71. Losing issues beat gainers on a margin of 11 to 10 on total volume of 671 million shares.

Ascend Communications Inc, the most active Nasdaq issue, shed 6-1/4 to 41-3/8 after UBS Securities and SoundView Financial Group downgraded the stock. Cascade Communications Corp, which is expected to complete its merger with Ascend by June 30, fell 4-5/16 to 28-9/16. Cisco Systems Inc slipped 1-1/2 to 65.

"Ascend put some of the other networking stocks under pressure. Intel's off ... and that was a lot of the OTC decline today," said Patrick Davis, head of over-the-counter trading at Salomon Brothers. "It's a little early to tell, but we may get some kind of follow on the downside tomorrow."
Applied Materials Inc dropped 3-5/8 to 60-3/4 after Hambrecht & Quist downgraded the stock and two other semiconductor equipment makers.
